criteria.3: starter dropbacks CRPS: R3 - R2 < -2 SE
criteria.4: starter passing yards CRPS: R3 - R2 <= +1 SE

dependence: The window's games are R1's registered test games and R2-H1's. R1's statistics are game-level and R2-H1's who-got-the-ball; R3's are the quarterback's pull and his line, a different question, frozen here before any of those games was played. Errors are correlated through the shared games (a blowout-heavy stretch moves all three), so joint passes are not independent confirmations; each test's own false-pass rate is unchanged. R3 is not tuned on R1's or R2's results: none has been read. Any change to R3 or to the R1/R2 files it plays on fails the pinned hashes, and moves R3 to fresh games under a new registration (the owner's ruling, 2026-11-27).
power: development, 2025 / 2026 weeks 1-12. Stage 1: +0.283 / +0.261 nats a team-game at SE 0.042 / 0.047 (544 / 328 team-games); at ~190 team-games SE ~0.072, z ~3.6, power ~0.95. Starter dropbacks CRPS: -0.363 +/- 0.049 / -0.181 +/- 0.057 (448 / 232 team-games); at ~190, z ~4.8 / ~2.9, power ~1.0 / ~0.82. Passing yards CRPS: -1.45 +/- 0.30 / -0.71 +/- 0.41; 'not worse than +1 SE' holds with probability ~0.99. Jointly ~0.78-0.94; the likeliest failure is criterion 3 if 2026's smaller dropbacks gain is the truth
